title: PICO PARK:Classic Edition
provenance: Reported by Michael-Liendo (upstream#281, 2026-10-02), Apple M4, macOS 27.0, KLYC-Box 0.10.2, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r17, DXVK as the environment's mode, rated 5 of 5 after 1 minute, recipe steam. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: The 2016 edition, which Steam no longer sells (its store page says it is no longer available; the 2021 PICO PARK is Steam 1509960 and a separate game), so this row is for people who already own it. Reported perfect on DXVK on the default engine after a one-minute session, enough for the menu and a first room. Co-op with other players is the whole game and the report does not say whether a session with others was tried. No frame rate was given and nothing was measured here.
